name: option-test-1b0c555df9/option_with_types_spaced-v.bal
spec_references: Module-level declarations: Supports required-params, defaultable-params, included-record-param and rest-param in the signature
reason: The test requires command-line option binding into an included record parameter: spaced --union, --name, --age, --score and --value options must convert strings to the declared field types, including nullable string and decimal exponent input. The subset supports included-record parameter signatures and member access, but does not cover command-line option parsing or entry-point argument conversion. That essential asserted behavior makes the whole case a feature.
unsupported_constructs: Command-line spaced option parsing and typed conversion into an included record main parameter
test_design_notes: The @args and @output annotations assert CLI conversion results, including decimal 1e10 rendered as 1E+10; io:println is instrumentation.
